captures.summary: Akhet I, day 13 of the season — year 425 of the 1460-year Sothic cycle since the 139 CE anchor.
captures.method: Ptolemy’s Era of Nabonassar epoch (1 Thoth, Year 1 = 26 Feb 747 BCE Julian). 12 months of 30 days across 3 seasons (Akhet/Peret/Shemu) plus 5 epagomenal days, with no leap day ever -- the wandering year drifts about 1 day every 4 years against the solar year, completing a Sothic cycle (Censorinus’s 139 CE anchor) in about 1460 years. Season hieroglyphs are omitted pending a confidently verified Gardiner-sign-to-Unicode mapping. This is Ptolemy’s own attested civil-calendar arithmetic, not a modern reconstruction.
